correctness.rationale: Every geometrically smooth plane cubic over F2 has at most floor(3+2sqrt2)=5 F2-points by Hasse–Weil. The group PGL3(F2) is transitive on the 21 five-element Fano-plane subsets; for one fixed S, five linear evaluation constraints leave exactly 32 ternary cubic forms, and the homogeneous Jacobian-quadratic rank-15 criterion (equivalent to no common geometric projective zero, by the three-quadrics regular-sequence Hilbert series (1+t)^3) leaves exactly smooth encodings 60 and 172. Their displayed gradients also have no common projective zero. Hence every five-set lies on one unordered smooth pair and there are exactly 21, one orbit with stabilizer size 8. The third pencil member f+g=xz(x+z) has three concurrent lines; line restrictions of f yield divisor 5p+p1+p2+p3+p4, exhausting Bézout length 9 and proving scheme support/multiplicities (5,1,1,1,1), with p the third point on the line through omitted rational points. Fresh independently constructed GF2 Jacobian-rank census over all 1023 nonzero coefficient vectors gave 336 smooth cubics and 56280 unordered pairs with intersection histogram (12740,22575,14448,5488,1008,21). The separate assigned Gröbner-chart and binomial-moment verification file was inspected; its complementary algorithm covers all finite masks.
